question: Who was called the 'Grand Old Man of India' and the first Indian to demand Swaraj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji** was famously known as the **'Grand Old Man of India'** due to his immense contribution to India's freedom struggle and his relentless advocacy for Indian rights.
 
• He was the first Indian to demand **Swaraj (self-rule)** in the late 19th century, emphasizing the importance of self-governance for India under British rule.
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji was one of the founding members of the **Indian National Congress** (INC), which played a pivotal role in India's independence movement.
 
• He authored the famous economic critique, **'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'**, where he explained the economic exploitation of India by the British, which led to the concept of the **'Drain of Wealth'**.
